fr.recommendations:
• Trim vegetation along the access road to maintain clear sightlines for approaching emergency vehicles.

• Mark all access points with visible building identification numbers readable from the street and internal drive aisle.

• Keep the internal drive aisle clear of parked vehicles to allow unobstructed emergency vehicle movement between access points.

• Mark the primary and secondary access points with reflective signage to help responders identify entry routes quickly, especially in low-light conditions.

• Trim dense landscaped areas near building entrances and walkways to maintain clear visibility for responders moving on foot.

• Keep the area around the dumpster enclosure clear to prevent it from blocking vehicle movement or obscuring access to adjacent building walls.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that extend over or directly toward building rooflines and walls.
• Remove dead grass and dry ground-level vegetation from areas where it contacts building foundations or walls.
• Thin shrubs and low vegetation within the landscaped island areas that are located close to buildings.
• Keep the base of large trees near buildings clear of accumulated dead leaves, bark, and dry plant material.
• Maintain separation between tree clusters and building exteriors by removing branches from the sides of trees facing the structures.
• Keep paved areas and drive lanes free of grass or vegetation growing through cracks or along edges that connect vegetated areas to buildings.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging tree branches that could limit vehicle clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Maintain open paved areas free of stored materials, equipment, or debris that could reduce usable space for emergency response.
